metadata.description: SEO skills for Webflow sites — content refresh, optimization, and ranking recovery powered by Webflow MCP.

plugins.name: getting-started
plugins.description: One-time setup that captures business goals, audience, markets, brand voice, SEO and AEO constraints. Saves to your AI config file.

plugins.name: refresh-content
plugins.description: Refresh and optimize Webflow blog articles for SEO — updates dates, meta tags, keywords, internal links, FAQs, and schema markup.

plugins.name: click-recovery
plugins.description: Find pages with high impressions but low CTR — get recommendations and publish optimized meta titles and descriptions directly to Webflow.

plugins.name: monthly-report
plugins.description: Monthly SEO report — what changed, why it matters, and what to do next. Performance overview, content analysis, technical health, and a prioritized action plan.

plugins.name: weekly-report
plugins.description: Weekly SEO pulse — what changed this week, how it tracks against the month, and what to do now. Same depth as monthly, weekly cadence.

plugins.name: audit
plugins.description: Quick SEO & AEO maturity audit from a public URL. 5-level scoring across 4 dimensions with deterministic checks. No MCP needed.

plugins.name: audit-deep
plugins.description: Deep SEO & AEO maturity audit with GSC + Webflow data. Indexation, content gaps, cannibalization, CMS template analysis, and data-backed scoring.

plugins.name: cms-collection-setup
plugins.description: Review or create a Webflow CMS collection optimized for SEO — audits existing schemas against a recommended field structure, or builds a new collection with the full set of Core, Content, Authority, Enhancement, and Social fields.

plugins.name: keywords-opportunity
plugins.description: Discover keyword opportunities using GSC and Keywords Everywhere — surfaces striking distance keywords, uncovers new opportunities, and researches keywords for new pages, products, or topic clusters before you create them.

plugins.name: aeo-optimize
plugins.description: Transform any Webflow page or CMS item into an AEO-ready answer — query alignment, direct answers, question-based structure, FAQ + schema markup, and internal linking. Works on both CMS and static pages.

plugins.name: write-blog
plugins.description: Create a new SEO and AEO-optimized blog draft in Webflow CMS — keyword expansion, outline approval, AI tell-tales check, humanizer pass, AEO audit, and CMS item creation via Webflow MCP.

plugins.name: topic-map
plugins.description: Turn keyword exports, URL lists, and GSC data into a structured topic map — per-cluster keyword ownership tables, product page tracking, editorial→product linking status, gap analysis, cannibalization detection, and a 90-day editorial calendar.

plugins.name: ai-visibility
plugins.description: Baseline AI visibility report. Pulls AEO Copilot data (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AIO) and renders a single-page client-ready HTML diagnostic with evidence-backed findings, per-LLM scorecards, topic performance, competitor share-of-voice, and external source influence. Print-styled for Cmd+P → PDF.

plugins.name: aeo-onboard
plugins.description: Bootstrap a brand in AEO Copilot end-to-end from a URL — analyze the site, create the brand, run the technical audit, design 5 buyer-journey topics with listicle prompts, and trigger the first tracking cycle. Hands off to /ai-visibility for the baseline report.
